label: D1 after a first common a2->S2 loss, when the agent will still stay with a2 (mid/late episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), only when the reward input is 0, and essentially only when the previous trial was a2 reaching S2 by a common transition (all activations with known history have prev_action=2, prev_common=1). So it marks an unrewarded common a2->S2 outcome. Base predicate (D1, prev unrewarded a2 common) gets recall 0.84 but precision 0.27. Precision rises when we add: the agent stays with a2 on this trial (action==2, the agent own upcoming choice; it is marked FUTURE but the agent computes it, and the policy logit is moderately pro-a2 at these steps); episode trial 40-89 (the feature is silent before trial ~30 and after 90, a strong time-in-episode effect); and the trial before was not also a loss (it fires on the first loss in a row, mostly not on the second). Dev: P 0.77, R 0.74, F1 0.75, mass recall 0.78. Most remaining misses are rel -3 D1 steps, where the previous trial lies outside the window. It does not fire after rewarded trials, after a1 or rare transitions, or when the agent is about to switch to a1. Magnitude is not modeled; it is active in the value bins below the median and the choice bin from -4.4 to -1.5.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 3 (9 = most a1) (+5.20), phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 4 (9 = most a1) (+3.68), phase=D1 & last=a2 S2 u (+2.95), phase=D1 & ep_dec=4 (+1.75), ep_dec=4 (+1.71), phase=D1 & this=a2 S2 (+1.69).
